name: receipt
description: Shows what each turn did in a band above the prompt: files changed, commands, failures, reads and subagents.

visible.title: Show the receipt
visible.description: Show the receipt above the prompt between turns; /receipt off and /receipt on set this too

repeatFailures.title: Repeated failure alert
repeatFailures.description: Toast when the same call fails this many times in a row with no file changed in between; 0 off

flipFlops.title: Back-and-forth edit alert
flipFlops.description: Toast when edits to a file put back what an earlier edit took out this many times; 0 off

flagUnverified.title: Flag unverified changes
flagUnverified.description: Mark the receipt when code changed after the turn's last test, build, lint or type check, or with none run

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the receipt, /receipt and the alerts; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
